mapper.select: SELECT tpd.TRADE_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tpda.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, ptrd.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION as BUSI_PS, ftp.BASIS, tpd.TRADE_DATE, ftp.VDATE, ftp.MDATE, ftp.TERM, ftp.CALENDAR_ID, tpd.CCY, ftp.PRIN, ftp.INT_RATE * 100 as INT_RATE, tpd.REMARK, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT, ptrd.DEPT_CODE, fpt.TYPE_6 as PA_BUSS_TYPE FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON (case when tpd.IS_OUT_TRADE='N' and tpd.R_TRADE_ID is not null then tpd.R_TRADE_ID else tpd.TRADE_ID end) = fpt.FINPROD_ID and fpt.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0} LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ptrd ON ptrd.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp ON (case when tpd.IS_OUT_TRADE='N' and tpd.R_TRADE_ID is not null then tpd.R_TRADE_ID else tpd.TRADE_ID end) = ftp.FINPROD_ID and ftp.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0} LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON tpd.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND tpd.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
select max(TRADE_ID) from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId}
